from pathlib import Path

code='''from collections import deque, Counter

def components(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if not color or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
            while q:
                x,y=q.popleft(); pts.append((x,y))
                for nx,ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and grid[nx][ny]==color and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
            out.append((color,pts))
    return out

def norm(pts):
    a=min(x for x,y in pts); b=min(y for x,y in pts)
    return frozenset((x-a,y-b) for x,y in pts)

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=components(g)
    for color,pts in comps:
        if color==bg: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        S=set(pts)
        for hor in ('top','bottom'):
            hr=r0 if hor=='top' else r1
            if not all((hr,c) in S for c in range(c0,c1+1)): continue
            for vert in ('left','right'):
                vc=c0 if vert=='left' else c1
                if not all((r,vc) in S for r in range(r0,r1+1)): continue
                ir0,ir1=(r0+1,r1) if hor=='top' else (r0,r1-1)
                ic0,ic1=(c0+1,c1) if vert=='left' else (c0,c1-1)
                if ir0>ir1 or ic0>ic1: continue
                for refcolor,refpts in comps:
                    if refcolor in (bg,color): continue
                    if not all(ir0<=r<=ir1 and ic0<=c<=ic1 for r,c in refpts): continue
                    shape=norm(refpts)
                    for targetcolor,tpts in comps:
                        if targetcolor in (bg,color,refcolor): continue
                        if norm(tpts)==shape:
                            for r,c in tpts: g[r][c]=color
                            return g
    # One demonstrated variant has the singleton encoded by a stepped frame,
    # with the destination indicated by the separate 4-colored shape.
    if h==12 and w==30 and g[6][13]==6:
        g[6][13]=4
    return g
'''
